title: Coded SNOMED concepts shown at Save & complete are missing from the final record
services: SNOMED-CT coder
annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: In C03 (session uk_2a3d583dccb643168cac5d77045eff7a), the clinician accepted 4 SNOMED concepts visible on screen at approximately 14:07; the final record shows snomed_selected as null at 14:11:16, and SNOMED-CT is absent from every summary event after the 14:00:00 regeneration. Accepts are logged as 'reject'. The reopened case shows no codes and no warning is shown. C01 (session uk_965b1a93904941a9b8f74ca07b185af7) lost its codes the same way and recovered only because a later accept re-sent them.
expected: SNOMED selections survive regeneration; the final stored record equals exactly what the clinician sees at Save & complete; the UI reloads SNOMED state from the server.

title: Transcript send silently regenerates Summary and For Patient, discarding clinician edits
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: In C01 (session uk_965b1a93904941a9b8f74ca07b185af7), the template value 'Weight (kg): 100 kg' was stored at 09:23:49.925 but was absent after the 09:37:57 regeneration triggered by a transcript send. In C03 (session uk_2a3d583dccb643168cac5d77045eff7a), a Summary edit stored at 13:57:37 was gone after the 14:00:00 regeneration. The intermediate version shown on screen between edits and regeneration is not present in the export.
expected: Clinician-authored content in the Summary and For Patient is preserved when a transcript is sent; either the regeneration does not overwrite clinician edits, or the clinician is warned and must confirm before any overwrite occurs. Every generated version is stored with its timestamp.

title: Template field values and Confirm and Copy attestations are not stored
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: In C01 (session uk_965b1a93904941a9b8f74ca07b185af7), 'Weight 100 kg' was shown in the template (17/31 fields) at 09:23:47; the final stored field shows status 'not_discussed', value null, and no attestedAt; the audit event holds only the field ID. In C03 (session uk_2a3d583dccb643168cac5d77045eff7a), 8/20 fields shown on screen fell to 4/20 in the stored record. All template edits and Confirm and Copy attestations are absent from the final record.
expected: Each template field value is stored with actor, timestamp, and attestation record; clinician-entered values are not re-extracted or overwritten by subsequent operations.

title: SNOMED coder offers 'Matched' codes that the backend has blocked
services: SNOMED-CT coder
annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: Across all five cases, 13 SNOMED cards are displayed with a '✓ Matched' label and an active Add button, but the backend stores these with writeback_allowed: false. Examples: C02 suspected UTI shown as UTI 68566005; C02 mother's breast cancer shown as 'No FH of breast cancer…' (listed as suppressed in the record); C05 'no known drug allergy' offers Allergy to drug 416098002. There are 98 Add options affected in total.
expected: Only codes with writeback_allowed: true are offered with an Add button; codes the backend has blocked are either not shown or are clearly flagged as unavailable and cannot be added.

title: For Patient contains advice and safety reassurance never given during the consultation
services: speaker annotation LLM, Summary generation
context: In C05 (session uk_f8ae0d60c239415f98ffcf4422cf3308), the For Patient text includes 'there's no need to seek emergency help unless something changes significantly', which was not said during the consultation. In C02 (session uk_a0ab871d6fd34beeaed99100f84d6411), the For Patient includes 'with water… finish the full course', which was also not spoken. Both instances were confirmed by Dr Nelson Lau as content never given.
expected: For Patient contains only content grounded in the consultation transcript; no unprompted safety reassurance or clinical advice is generated.

title: SNOMED coder blocks an affirmed symptom because a neighbouring negated term shares its negation scope
services: SNOMED-CT coder
context: In C05 (session uk_f8ae0d60c239415f98ffcf4422cf3308), 'breathlessness' is blocked by the coder because of the phrase 'without chest pain', even though the patient reported breathlessness. In C02 (session uk_a0ab871d6fd34beeaed99100f84d6411), 'nausea' is blocked because of 'no vomiting', even though nausea was affirmed.
expected: Negation in the polarity guard applies only to the specific negated term; an affirmed symptom that appears near a negated but distinct term is not blocked.
